entries.prompt: Create a production 2x2 four-frame sprite animation sheet on a truly transparent background. Reference image is the canonical Enforcer LEVEL 2 design, preserve exactly red rounded helmet with dark central band and thin cyan visor, circular ear pieces, spiked shoulder plates, red armor with cyan edge piping, two identical short cyan glowing tonfa (one in EACH hand), black gloves and armored boots. Same painterly polished mobile-game rendering. RETREAT / BACKWARD WALK loop while always facing screen-right in 3/4 side view. Exactly four complete full-body figures, equal scale/camera, each wholly within its quadrant with at least 8% transparent margin. No floor/shadow/text/panel lines. Row-major sequence: 1 near leg stepping BACK to screen-left, far foot planted forward; 2 weight transfers onto near rear foot, far boot lifts and passes backward under hips; 3 far leg now extended BACK screen-left, near foot planted forward; 4 weight transfers onto far rear foot, near boot lifted passing back under hips, then loops to1. Crucial alternating left/right feet and actual backward travel gait, not four same stance copies. Torso leans slightly toward screen-right, visor watches opponent screen-right, both tonfas defensively in front or down at hips, both always visible. Keep every boot, spike, baton and glow inside its own panel. Wide generous gutters. Sheet square.
entries.status: rejected: same leading leg in all frames
